stages.title: CRITICAL STARTING PROBLEM AND THE RATIONALISM-EMPIRICISM SYNTHESIS

pills.text: CRITICAL STARTING PROBLEM AND THE RATIONALISM-EMPIRICISM SYNTHESIS
HOW CAN COGNITION BE INFORMATIVE, NECESSARY AND OBJECTIVELY VALID?
A PRIORI NECESSITY, BUT DOGMATIC CLAIMS ABOUT SOUL, WORLD
SENSORY CONTENT, BUT NO EXPERIENCED NECESSARY CONNECTION
KANTIAN CRITIQUE
SENSORY MATTER + A PRIORI FORM, RESTRICTED TO POSSIBLE
COPERNICAN REVOLUTION
OBJECTS AS EXPERIENCED CONFORM TO COGNITIVE CONDITIONS

sequence: CENTRAL QUESTION: How can cognition be informative, necessary and objectively valid?
RATIONALISM → a priori necessity, but dogmatic claims about soul, world and God
EMPIRICISM / HUME → sensory content, but no experienced necessary connection
KANTIAN CRITIQUE → sensory matter + a priori form, restricted to possible experience
COPERNICAN REVOLUTION → objects AS EXPERIENCED conform to cognitive conditions

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: COPERNICAN REVOLUTION → objects AS EXPERIENCED conform to cognitive conditions
SENSIBILITY → intuitions in space/time → UNDERSTANDING → categories and objects
UNDERSTANDING → REASON → Ideas of Soul, World and God; drive to the unconditioned
TRANSCENDENTAL = conditions of possible experience; TRANSCENDENT = beyond experience

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: RESULT → empirical realism + transcendental idealism + limit on theoretical reason
ANSWER LINE → Kant secures objectivity by making its a priori conditions mind-given.

stages.mechanism_strip: Sensory matter is received under space and time, synthesised through categories, and pursued toward unity by reason.
stages.answer_line: Kant retains rationalist necessity and empirical content under a critical limit: objects as experienced conform to a priori conditions, not to private creation.

stages.mechanism_strip: Synthetic a priori judgments are possible because objects of experience must conform to a priori forms of cognition.
stages.answer_line: Synthetic a priori judgments are possible because objects of possible experience must conform to the mind's a priori forms, so mathematics and fundamental natural principles articulate conditions under which anything can appear as an object for us.

stages.title: TRANSCENDENTAL AESTHETIC: SPACE AND TIME AS FORMS OF INTUITION

pills.text: TRANSCENDENTAL AESTHETIC
SPACE AND TIME AS FORMS OF INTUITION
FORM OF INTUITION
A PRIORI WAY IN WHICH SENSORY MATTER CAN BE
PURE FORM OF OUTER SENSE; COEXISTENCE, EXTERNALITY AND GEOMETRY
PURE FORM OF INNER SENSE; SUCCESSION AND ALL REPRESENTATIONS
A PRIORI ARGUMENT
SPATIAL/TEMPORAL ORDERING PRESUPPOSES, NOT PRODUCES, THE FORMS

sequence: FORM OF INTUITION → a priori way in which sensory matter can be given
SPACE → pure form of OUTER sense; coexistence, externality and geometry
TIME → pure form of INNER sense; succession and all representations
A PRIORI ARGUMENT → spatial/temporal ordering presupposes, not produces, the forms
NECESSITY ARGUMENT → empty space/time is representable; objects without them are not

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: FORM OF INTUITION → a priori way in which sensory matter can be given
SPACE → pure form of OUTER sense; coexistence, externality and geometry
TIME → pure form of INNER sense; succession and all representations
A PRIORI ARGUMENT → spatial/temporal ordering presupposes, not produces, the forms

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: NECESSITY ARGUMENT → empty space/time is representable; objects without them are not
INTUITION ARGUMENT → one space/time; regions and periods are limitations within it
INFINITY ARGUMENT → magnitude is represented as a given whole, not instances under a concept
EMPIRICALLY REAL → objectively valid for every appearance and possible experience

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: TRANSCENDENTALLY IDEAL → not properties of things in themselves
OBJECTION → modern geometry/science pressures examples, not the whole transcendental strategy

stages.mechanism_strip: Space and time precede and organise sensory relations, allowing geometry, arithmetic, motion and ordered experience.
stages.answer_line: Space and time are a priori forms that are transcendentally ideal yet empirically real; geometry and relativity pressure examples, not this distinction by slogan.

stages.title: CATEGORIES, SYNTHESIS AND TRANSCENDENTAL UNITY OF APPERCEPTION

pills.text: CATEGORIES, SYNTHESIS AND TRANSCENDENTAL UNITY OF APPERCEPTION
METAPHYSICAL DEDUCTION
IDENTIFIES CATEGORIES FROM FUNCTIONS OF JUDGMENT
TRANSCENDENTAL DEDUCTION
JUSTIFIES THEIR OBJECTIVE APPLICATION
SYNTHESIS UNDER RULES
'I THINK' CAN ACCOMPANY EACH REPRESENTATION
FORMAL UNITY OF SELF-CONSCIOUSNESS, NOT EMPIRICAL EGO OR SOUL-SUBSTANCE

sequence: QUANTITY → Unity
QUALITY → Reality
RELATION → Inherence/Subsistence
MODALITY → Possibility/Impossibility
METAPHYSICAL DEDUCTION → identifies categories from functions of judgment

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: QUANTITY → Unity
QUALITY → Reality
RELATION → Inherence/Subsistence
MODALITY → Possibility/Impossibility

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: METAPHYSICAL DEDUCTION → identifies categories from functions of judgment
TRANSCENDENTAL DEDUCTION → justifies their objective application
MANIFOLD → SYNTHESIS under rules → 'I THINK' can accompany each representation
APPERCEPTION → formal unity of self-consciousness, not empirical ego or soul-substance

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: OBJECTIVE UNITY → the same rule unites representations as one experience of objects
LIMIT → categories constitute appearances only; they do not picture or determine noumena

stages.mechanism_strip: Space/time give a manifold; apperceptive unity requires synthesis through categories, while schemata provide temporal rules of application.
stages.answer_line: The Transcendental Deduction justifies categories by showing that unified self-conscious experience is possible only through rule-governed synthesis, so the categories constitute objects of experience without depicting noumenal things.

stages.title: SCHEMATISM: TEMPORAL BRIDGE FROM PURE CATEGORY TO APPEARANCE

pills.text: TEMPORAL BRIDGE FROM PURE CATEGORY TO APPEARANCE
PURE INTELLECTUAL CATEGORY AND SENSIBLE PARTICULAR APPEARANCE ARE HETEROGENEOUS
RULE/PROCEDURE OF PRODUCTIVE IMAGINATION; NEVER A DETERMINATE MENTAL IMAGE
WHY TIME?
IT IS A PRIORI LIKE THE CATEGORY AND CONTAINS
NUMBER THROUGH SUCCESSIVE HOMOGENEOUS ADDITION
DEGREE OR INTENSIVE MAGNITUDE
PERMANENCE, SUCCESSION BY RULE, RECIPROCAL COEXISTENCE

sequence: PROBLEM → pure intellectual category and sensible particular appearance are heterogeneous
SCHEMA → rule/procedure of productive imagination; never a determinate mental image
WHY TIME? → it is a priori like the category and contains every representation
QUANTITY / time-series → NUMBER through successive homogeneous addition
QUALITY / time-content → DEGREE or intensive magnitude

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: PROBLEM → pure intellectual category and sensible particular appearance are heterogeneous
SCHEMA → rule/procedure of productive imagination; never a determinate mental image
WHY TIME? → it is a priori like the category and contains every representation
QUANTITY / time-series → NUMBER through successive homogeneous addition

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: QUALITY / time-content → DEGREE or intensive magnitude
RELATION / time-order → permanence, succession by rule, reciprocal coexistence
MODALITY / time-scope → some time, determinate time, all times
DEDUCTION proves THAT categories apply; SCHEMATISM explains HOW they apply

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: UNSCHEMATISED CATEGORY → logical function without objective sense for appearances
RESIDUAL → Kant calls the mediating operation an art concealed in the human soul

stages.mechanism_strip: Time-series, time-content, time-order and time-scope mediate Quantity, Quality, Relation and Modality.
stages.answer_line: Schematism converts logical functions into rules of temporal application, explaining how the Deduction's entitlement becomes usable for appearances while leaving unschematised categories without objective sense.

stages.title: ANALOGIES OF EXPERIENCE AND KANT'S PRECISE ANSWER TO HUME

pills.text: ANALOGIES OF EXPERIENCE AND KANT'S PRECISE ANSWER TO HUME
MASTER PREMISE
TIME ITSELF CANNOT BE PERCEIVED; OBJECTIVE TIME NEEDS PROXIES
FIRST ANALOGY
SUBSTANCE PERSISTS WHILE ITS STATES ALTER
SECOND ANALOGY
EVERY EVENT FOLLOWS ACCORDING TO A CAUSAL RULE
THIRD ANALOGY

sequence: MASTER PREMISE → time itself cannot be perceived; objective time needs proxies
FIRST ANALOGY / duration → substance persists while its states alter
SECOND ANALOGY / succession → every event follows according to a causal rule
THIRD ANALOGY / simultaneity → substances coexist through reciprocal community
HOUSE → viewing order is reversible; succession belongs to my apprehension

stages.mechanism_strip: Persistent substance, irreversible succession under a rule, and reciprocal interaction act as proxies for duration, succession and simultaneity.
stages.answer_line: Kant answers Hume by arguing that causality is not inferred from repetition but presupposed in judging a succession as an objective event, though particular causal laws remain empirical.

stages.title: PHENOMENA, NOUMENA, EMPIRICAL REALISM AND THE IDEALISM BOUNDARY

pills.text: PHENOMENA, NOUMENA, EMPIRICAL REALISM AND THE IDEALISM BOUNDARY
OBJECT AS GIVEN IN SPACE/TIME AND THOUGHT THROUGH CATEGORIES
POSSIBLE EXPERIENCE
KNOWABLE, PUBLIC, CAUSAL AND SCIENTIFICALLY INVESTIGABLE DOMAIN
NOUMENON NEGATIVELY
THING CONSIDERED APART FROM SENSIBLE INTUITION; LIMITING CONCEPT
NOUMENON IS THINKABLE, NOT KNOWABLE
NO THEORETICAL PREDICATES FROM THE CATEGORIES

sequence: PHENOMENON → object as given in space/time and thought through categories
POSSIBLE EXPERIENCE → knowable, public, causal and scientifically investigable domain
NOUMENON NEGATIVELY → thing considered apart from sensible intuition; limiting concept
NOUMENON IS THINKABLE, NOT KNOWABLE → no theoretical predicates from the categories
TRANSCENDENTAL IDEALISM → our forms condition appearances

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: TRANSCENDENTAL IDEALISM → our forms condition appearances
EMPIRICAL REALISM → external objects are real within experience, not private illusions
REFUTATION → determinate inner time-awareness requires an empirically external permanent
TWO-ASPECT READING → one object considered as appearance and independently of our access

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: HEGEL/JACOBI PRESSURE → boundary knowledge and affection threaten internal consistency
SAFE VERDICT → negative limitation is defensible; positive noumenal causation is not

stages.mechanism_strip: Cognitive conditions establish the knowable phenomenal domain and simultaneously forbid constitutive claims beyond it.
stages.answer_line: Negative noumenon limits sensible cognition; positive noumenon would require intellectual intuition humans lack, and the affection problem remains.

stages.title: IDEAS OF REASON, REGULATIVE UNITY AND NATURAL TRANSCENDENTAL ILLUSION

pills.text: IDEAS OF REASON, REGULATIVE UNITY AND NATURAL TRANSCENDENTAL ILLUSION
SUPPLIES RULES FOR APPEARANCES; REASON
SEEKS THE UNCONDITIONED
PROJECTED COMPLETE UNITY OF INNER CONDITIONS
PROJECTED COMPLETE TOTALITY OF COSMOLOGICAL CONDITIONS
PROJECTED COMPLETE GROUND OF ALL CONDITIONS AND REALITY
REGULATIVE USE
GUIDE INQUIRY TOWARD SYSTEMATIC UNITY; LEGITIMATE 'AS IF'

sequence: UNDERSTANDING → supplies rules for appearances; REASON → seeks the unconditioned
SOUL → projected complete unity of inner conditions
WORLD → projected complete totality of cosmological conditions
GOD → projected complete ground of all conditions and reality
REGULATIVE USE → guide inquiry toward systematic unity; legitimate 'as if'

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: UNDERSTANDING → supplies rules for appearances; REASON → seeks the unconditioned
SOUL → projected complete unity of inner conditions
WORLD → projected complete totality of cosmological conditions
GOD → projected complete ground of all conditions and reality

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: REGULATIVE USE → guide inquiry toward systematic unity; legitimate 'as if'
CONSTITUTIVE USE → claim the Idea determines a known object; illegitimate
TRANSCENDENTAL ILLUSION → natural and persistent drive to reify completion
PARALOGISM → logical 'I think' is misread as simple, substantial, enduring soul

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: VALUE → systematic research and explanatory integration
DANGER → paralogisms, antinomies and speculative theology

stages.mechanism_strip: Soul, world and God regulate systematic unity; the most-real being (ens realissimum) is the Ideal of complete determination.
stages.answer_line: Transcendental illusion is natural and persistent because reason cannot stop seeking completion, yet critique can prevent the slide from useful systematic unity to metaphysical claims about soul-substance, world-totality and God.

BEGINNING IN TIME + SPATIAL LIMIT
INFINITE TIME/SPACE
2 THESIS
COMPOSITES END IN SIMPLE PARTS
NOTHING SIMPLE EXISTS
3 THESIS

sequence: 1 THESIS → beginning in time + spatial limit
ANTITHESIS → infinite time/space

ANTITHESIS → nothing simple exists
3 THESIS → freedom besides nature

items: ANTITHESIS → universal natural causality

items: DYNAMICAL 3-4 → phenomenal conditions and intelligible standpoint can be distinguished

stages.mechanism_strip: Reason demands the unconditioned, turns a never-completed experiential series into a total object, and proves opposed predicates of that pseudo-object.
stages.answer_line: Antinomy starts when reason treats the unconditioned world-series as a completed object in itself rather than regulating inquiry.

stages.title: GOD-PROOF CRITIQUE, EVALUATION LEDGER, TRAPS, PYQS AND ANSWER SPINE

pills.text: GOD-PROOF CRITIQUE, EVALUATION LEDGER, TRAPS, PYQS AND ANSWER SPINE
PERFECT CONCEPT INCLUDES EXISTENCE
EXISTENCE ADDS NO CONTENT
100 POSSIBLE/ACTUAL THALERS
SAME CONCEPT; ACTUALITY CANNOT BE EXTRACTED ANALYTICALLY
CONTINGENT EXISTS, THEREFORE NECESSARY GOD
ILLICIT CAUSAL EXTENSION
COSMOLOGICAL DEPENDENCE

sequence: ONTOLOGICAL → perfect concept includes existence
KANT → existence adds no content
100 possible/actual thalers → same concept; actuality cannot be extracted analytically
COSMOLOGICAL → contingent exists, therefore necessary God
illicit causal extension

groups.heading: DOCTRINE / CLAIM
items: ONTOLOGICAL → perfect concept includes existence
KANT → existence adds no content
100 possible/actual thalers → same concept; actuality cannot be extracted analytically
COSMOLOGICAL → contingent exists, therefore necessary God
illicit causal extension

groups.heading: OBJECTION / PRESSURE
items: COSMOLOGICAL DEPENDENCE → necessary being = ens realissimum repeats ontological proof
DESIGN → order implies designer
at most an architect, not necessary creator
DESIGN DEPENDENCE → creator/necessity needs cosmological then ontological steps
BOUNDARY → theoretical proof fails; this is not a demonstration of atheism

groups.heading: REPLY / RESIDUAL
items: COMPARISON → rationalist necessity + empiricist content under critical limitation
PYQ ROUTES → synthesis, space/time, apperception, antinomies, Hume and God proofs
ANSWER SPINE → thesis → doctrine → argument → objection/reply → qualified verdict
FINAL VERDICT → Kant gains phenomenal objectivity at the cost of noumenal agnosticism

stages.mechanism_strip: All three routes attempt to turn thought beyond experience into constitutive knowledge, and the latter two ultimately require the ontological step.
stages.answer_line: Understanding constitutes lawful phenomenal Nature; Hegel both radicalizes constitutive thought and attacks Kant's fixed dualisms and unknowable remainder.
